Expo/React Native standards:
- Structure: `assets/` static assets; `src/` logic; `src/components/` reusable UI; `src/screens/` views; `src/navigation/` navigation (unless Expo Router `app/`); `src/hooks/` hooks; `src/utils/` utilities/constants; `src/services/` API/data.
- Naming: directories `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; hooks/utils `camelCase`; global constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; variables/functions `camelCase`.
- Always use functional components. All new code must be in TypeScript. Centralize styles with `StyleSheet`.
- Use `app/` directory for routing; avoid manual all-route stack/tab setup.
- Always create new objects/arrays when updating state. Carefully manage `useEffect` dependency arrays.
- Use `.env` client variables prefixed `EXPO_PUBLIC_`; never use unprefixed client variables.
- Never store sensitive keys (e.g., private API keys) in `EXPO_PUBLIC_` variables. They are bundled client-side. Use EAS Secrets for server-side secrets.
- Use `React.memo`, `useCallback`, and `useMemo` appropriately; lazy load large-app screens with `React.lazy`/`Suspense`.
- Handle async errors with `try/catch`; provide user-friendly messages. Add a global error boundary.
- Use Jest and React Testing Library; focus on logic/interactions; aim for ≥80% coverage. Add snapshot tests for UI components.
